results.title: Zimbabwe preacher Uebert Angel appears in court in handcuffs over assault allegations
results.content: The prosecution is opposing bail, arguing that Angel poses a flight risk because of his international connections, financial means and possession of two passports. Prosecutors have also raised concerns about possible interference with witnesses.

results.title: Memorial service honours late South African deputy president
results.content: Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka was the country's first female deputy president and a champion of women's rights, leading UN Women until 2021.

results.title: China pushes back against US plans for new tariffs
results.content: Beijing pushed back on Wednesday against US plans to raise tariffs on China, the European Union, and other countries.

results.title: Zimbabwe court issues arrest warrant for Robert Mugabe’s son
results.content: Bellarmine Chatunga Mugabe, who was arrested earlier this month, had failed to appear for a routine hearing on Tuesday.

results.title: Ex-French president and wife to face trial in witness tampering case
results.content: The case relates to the retraction by Nicolas Sarkozy's main accuser of allegations of Libyan financing of his 2007 presidential campaign.

results.title: A day without news: Media outlets in CAR go dark to protest 'intimidation'
results.content: Media outlets in Central African Republic observed a day without news on Wednesday to spotlight the mounting pressure on independent journalism.

results.title: The house that fell on its head: Crazy sculptures trick the eye in Marrakesh
results.content: It seems to have been dropped on its roof. This is "The House Fallen from the Sky" in Ramakech sculpture park in Morocco. The 11 hectare space is home to unconventional artworks. Created by French artist Jean-François Fourtou in 2010, the house features an interior where every detail is upside down.

results.title: South African court convicts Zimbabwean man of trying to join Russian war
results.content: A South African court convicted a Zimbabwean man on Tuesday of trying to travel to Russia to join its war against Ukraine. Defendant Tafadzwa Sithole said he’d applied online and been promised remuneration for agreeing to fight.

results.title: Morocco to challenge ruling reinstating Senegal as AFCON champions
results.content: Morocco’s Football Federation has vowed to pursue “all necessary legal avenues" after the Court of Arbitration for Sport reinstated Senegal as winners of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations.

results.title: Cameroon separatist leader pleads not guilty at Norway war crimes trial
results.content: Cameroon separatist leader Lucas Cho Ayaba pleaded not guilty to being an accessory to war crimes and terrorism in a Norwegian court on Tuesday.

results.title: Cameroon crushed 4-0 by Mexico after second-half collapse
results.content: Cameroon were beaten 4-0 by Mexico in their Group K match, despite a strong first-half effort from the Indomitable Lions.

results.title: IMF approves $425 million economic and financial programme for Guinea
results.content: The International Monetary Fund approved a $425 million economic and financial program for Guinea on Monday, the government said on Monday.

results.title: Tanzania fall to Brazil in Under-17 World Cup Group I
results.content: Tanzania’s Taifa Stars suffered a narrow 1-0 defeat to Brazil in their Group I match, despite a determined defensive display against the Samba Boys.

results.title: Mauritania and European Union reach new fisheries agreement
results.content: Mauritania and the EU have reached a new fisheries deal allowing European vessels to access the African nation's waters. Both parties were previously bound by a fisheries agreement valued at approximately $62.7 million a year.

results.title: Amnesty calls for probe into possible war crimes in Ethiopia's Tigray
results.content: Amnesty International called Tuesday for an investigation into possible war crimes by the Ethiopian army and its allies in the Tigray region.

results.title: DR Congo halts cobalt exports again amid drop in prices
results.content: The Democratic Republic of Congo will again suspend cobalt exports starting at the end of the month in an attempt to boost prices.

results.content: Senegal has officially been reinstated as the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations champion by the Court of Arbitration

results.title: Colombia: At least 25 injured in bombing as armed violence resurges
results.content: At least 25 people were injured in a bombing in Villavicencio, damaging government buildings, businesses and vehicles. Meanwhile, hundreds of residents marched with candles in Cúcuta following a separate attack, amid a resurgence of armed violence in Colombia.

results.title: Senegal reinstated as AFCON winners after CAS rules against Morocco
results.content: Senegal were reinstated as winners of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations on Tuesday, after a decision by the Court of Arbitration for Sport. The court overturned an earlier ruling which handed the trophy to Morocco.

results.title: Nvidia staff cheer Jensen Huang's return as CEO after spy scandal
results.content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was welcomed by cheers and applause from staff as he returned to the company's California headquarters on Monday, 11 days after his resignation.

results.title: France: Chefs compete for the world egg mayonnaise championship
results.content: Sixteen finalists gathered near Paris to compete for the title of world egg mayonnaise champion, held in Saint-Ouen, just outside Paris, on Monday 23 November 2026. The competition celebrates a deceptively simple French bistro classic that demands considerable culinary skill.

results.title: In Abidjan, Africa wants to shape its own demographic future
results.content: Early in November, Abidjan became the capital of the African demographic debate as the UNFPA, African Union and Côte d'Ivoire led talks on the future of the continent's population.

results.title: Haiti gang suppression force says it has killed multiple gang members
results.content: The force said at least six suspected gang members were killed and five rifles seized during clashes on the Marassa Bridge, which connects Tabarre to Croix-des-Bouquets, a stronghold of the powerful 400 Mawozo gang.

results.title: Madagascar seeks arrest warrants for former president Rajoelina and ex-premier
results.content: The two former leaders are facing accusations of complicity in financing terrorism and the acquisition of heavy weapons. The case centres on five Boeing 777s temporarily registered in Madagascar before being found in Iran in July 2025.

results.title: Indonesia: Search continues for workers trapped after deadly factory fire
results.content: The death toll from a devastating fire at a confectionery factory west of Jakarta has risen to 26. Rescue workers continue searching for victims trapped beneath the rubble.

results.title: DRC president says mineral wealth must benefit its people
results.content: Tshisekedi said the country must move beyond simply extracting resources and develop its capacity to process them locally.

results.title: US: Melania Trump welcomes the 2026 White House Christmas tree
results.content: US First Lady Melania Trump welcomed the official White House Christmas tree in Washington, DC, on Monday 23 November 2026, marking the start of the festive season at the presidential residence. The tree arrived in a horse-drawn carriage as part of the traditional annual ceremony.

results.title: Ecuador: Severe flooding hits Galápagos Islands amid El Niño concerns
results.content: Torrential rains have inundated parts of Ecuador's Galápagos Islands, forcing residents to flee their homes. Rescue teams have evacuated people by boat as communities struggle to salvage their belongings.

results.title: South African cities tighten water restrictions as El Niño threatens drought
results.content: The restrictions come as the country's weather service warns that the current El Niño event could rank among the strongest on record, with below-average rainfall and above-average temperatures expected over the coming summer months.
